- [x] I, the PR author, have personally reviewed every line of this PR.

# What does this PR do?

Reduces redundant NCCL communicator allocations by reusing eligible process groups with identical membership and creation settings.

Megatron creates separate groups for several parallelism roles even when they span the same ranks. With eager NCCL2 initialization, each duplicate allocates device memory immediately. In the configurations reported in #8668, this causes previously passing H100 training runs to exhaust device memory at iteration 2–3.

This patch:

- Caches plain NCCL groups by sorted ranks, timeout, backend, and `NCCL_COLLNET_ENABLE`. An omitted backend is resolved from the default process group.
- Excludes groups with custom `pg_options`, non-NCCL backends, local synchronization, or unspecified ranks.
- Preserves independent dense and expert all-gather communicators through `reuse_existing=False`, so those groups remain separate from their reduce-scatter counterparts.
- Provides `MEGATRON_DISABLE_PROCESS_GROUP_REUSE=1` for comparison and fallback. All ranks must use the same setting.
- Caches nonmember results as well, keeping group-creation decisions consistent across ranks. Clears the cache on model-parallel initialization and teardown, and retains the first group's description when reusing it.
- Adds focused regression coverage for reuse, exclusions, rank consistency, all-gather separation, and repeated initialization with a real collective.

## Evidence and review considerations

The experiment documented in [#8668](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/issues/8668) on MCore revision `a0f793dfa4e776d99a8aa63bed74e0fafc91b0db`. With the model settings and recorded dependencies held fixed:

| Workload | Reuse disabled | Reuse enabled | Group-creation calls |
|---|---|---|---|
| Llama3-8B, 8 × H100 | OOM at iteration 2 | Completed 30 iterations | 121 → 12 |
| Nemotron3-Nano, 16 × H100 | OOM at iteration 3 | Completed 30 iterations | 191 → 37 |

Counts are rank-0 `create_group()` calls, including groups that rank 0 does not join; they are not resident communicator counts per GPU. The issue contains the reproduction commands, environment details, and limitations of the historical comparison.

The 30-step results do not establish correctness or performance of this revision, long-run convergence, or all TP/PP/CP and communication-overlap configurations.

**Sharing a communicator changes stream and collective-ordering behavior**. Review should confirm which additional roles need distinct communicators even when their memberships match. The explicit all-gather exclusions cover the known AG/RS separation requirement; broader overlap behavior still needs GPU evaluation. Selective lazy initialization, as discussed in #8668, remains an alternative that preserves communicator identity.

## Issue tracking

Fixes #8668.

## Code provenance

No code copied from another repository.

## Contribution process

### Pre-checks

- [x] I have added relevant unit tests
- [ ] I have added relevant functional tests
- [ ] If this PR adds or changes a GPU kernel, I have added or updated its bit-exact determinism test and registered it in `tests/unit_tests/determinism/kernels/manifest.py` — not applicable
- [x] I have added proper typing to the new cache and helper
- [x] I have added relevant documentation in the process-group helper docstrings
- [x] I have run the [autoformatter.sh](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/main/tools/autoformat.sh) on my PR

### Code review

Keep this PR in draft for communicator-sharing design review and GPU validation. The linked issue records the design motivation and candidate tradeoffs. Request the `Run functional tests` label when the PR is opened.

Is a better fix to let each test (could be done in some test fixtures) clean up the process groups after itself? 

I've been doing this for the mfsdp_v2 bucket for the same memory-saving reason: https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/128d0970185fa74c5eadd8616903d6a14eb6bf08/tests/unit_tests/distributed/mfsdp_v2/conftest.py#L98-L100

In general, tests should be independent of other tests. See "Clean Code" Chapter 9. Reusing across tests increases the coupling, making them stateful and harder to debug.

I replayed `initialize_model_parallel()` on CPU with `new_group` mocked and grouped the parallel_state globals by object identity. With reuse off, the Llama layout joins 20 NCCL groups per rank: 14 single-rank groups and 6 that span all 8 ranks. This PR brings that to 2, which matches your numbers, so the saving is real.

My main concern is that keying on membership alone also merges groups that are meant to overlap. Details are inline. What I'd suggest instead is an explicit list of roles allowed to share a group, built per grid, plus `lazy_init` for the groups that stay separate.

On lazy init by itself: it won't recover enough here. `dp_cp` and the dist-opt grad-norm group communicate every step, so they'd still allocate. One catch when combining the two: the PR skips the cache for any group with `pg_options`, so passing `lazy_init` through `pg_options` would quietly turn reuse off for those groups.

Membership alone also merges groups that are meant to overlap. When expert DP is 1 (EP8 on one node, TP2 CP2 EP4, or PP×EP with EP equal to the per-stage DP), `EXPERT_MODEL_PARALLEL_GROUP` and `DATA_PARALLEL_GROUP_WITH_CP` become the same object. A `ProcessGroupNCCL` runs all of its collectives on one NCCL stream. The Megatron-FSDP docs have a probe showing that an RS and an AG on one group run back to back even when issued from different user streams (`megatron/core/distributed/fsdp/src/docs/runtime_schedule.md`). With overlap-grad-reduce, the alltoall dispatcher's A2A then waits behind in-flight grad RS buckets, and the overlapped param AG runs ahead of the forward A2A. CP at DP=1 has the same issue: `CONTEXT_PARALLEL_GROUP` merges with `DATA_PARALLEL_GROUP_WITH_CP`. Neither repro would show this. Llama has no EP, and the Nemotron layout has expert DP = 2.

I'd replace this with an explicit list of roles that may share a group:

- `dp`/`dp_cp` and `tp_dp`/`tp_dp_cp` when CP is 1
- the GTP-remat variants at size 1
- `expt_dp`/`dp_cp` when EP is 1 and ETP equals TP
- the dist-opt grad-norm group with any world-sized group
- one single-rank group per rank

Keep `ep`, `tp_ep`, `cp`, the hierarchical and dynamic CP groups, `pp`, and the AG groups separate. Main already aliases this way in one place (`_INTRA_PARTIAL_DATA_PARALLEL_GROUP_WITH_CP = _DATA_PARALLEL_GROUP_WITH_CP`).

nodes.body: Could this be a local dict passed into `create_group()` for one grid build, instead of module state? #8039 moves group creation into `build_process_group_collection()`, which isn't supposed to touch module state. Its parity test snapshots every `_UPPERCASE` global, so it would fail on this one. A global cache also hands a second collection built next to the registered grid that grid's groups, and the teardown in #7029 then destroys them while that collection still holds them. With a local cache, the clears in `initialize_model_parallel()` and `destroy_model_parallel()` go away too.

Could you add two tests?

- A grid-parametrized test that pins which roles share and which don't, for example `ep is not dp_cp` when expert DP is 1 and `cp is not dp_cp` at DP=1.
- A real multi-rank test that every rank makes the same `new_group()` calls on a grid where ranks join different groups (PP2 or EP2). The unit tests start WORLD without `device_id`, so the eager comm-split path, where a mismatched call would hang, isn't covered today.

On GPU, the A/B I'd want is a MoE layout with expert DP = 1 and overlap-grad-reduce, overlap-param-gather and A2A overlap on, comparing step time with reuse on and off on the same backend.

+from datetime import timedelta
+from unittest.mock import Mock
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+import megatron.core.parallel_state as ps
+from tests.unit_tests.test_utilities import Utils
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def group_factory(monkeypatch):
+    """Isolate the cache and record creation without allocating communicators."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ps, "_PROCESS_GROUP_CACHE", {})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ps, "_PROCESS_GROUP_REUSE_STATS", {"created": 0, "reused": 0})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ps, "_global_process_group_list", None)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.distributed, "get_rank", lambda: 0)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.distributed, "get_backend", lambda: "nccl")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ps, "is_torch_min_version", lambda version: True)
+    monkeypatch.delenv("MEGATRON_DISABLE_PROCESS_GROUP_REUSE", raising=False)
+    monkeypatch.delenv("NCCL_COLLNET_ENABLE", raising=False)
+    factory = Mock(side_effect=lambda **kwargs: object())
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.distributed, "new_group", factory)
+    return factory
+
+
+def test_reuse_identical_nccl_group(group_factory):
+    """Equivalent membership requests reuse one registered communicator."""
+    first = ps.create_group([0, 1], timeout=timedelta(minutes=1), group_desc="first")
+    second = ps.create_group(
+        [1, 0], timeout=timedelta(minutes=1), backend="nccl", group_desc="second"
+    )
+    assert second is first
+    assert group_factory.call_count == 1
+    assert group_factory.call_args.kwargs["group_desc"] == "first"
+    assert ps._global_process_group_list == [None, first]
+    assert ps._PROCESS_GROUP_REUSE_STATS == {"created": 1, "reused": 1}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("rank", range(4))
+def test_nonmembers_make_the_same_reuse_decision(group_factory, monkeypatch, rank):
+    """Members and nonmembers enter the same sequence of new_group calls."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.distributed, "get_rank", lambda: rank)
+    nonmember = torch.distributed.GroupMember.NON_GROUP_MEMBER
+    group_factory.side_effect = lambda **kwargs: object() if rank in kwargs["ranks"] else nonmember
+    for ranks in ([0, 1], [2, 3]):
+        first = ps.create_group(ranks)
+        second = ps.create_group(ranks)
+        assert second is first
+    assert [call.kwargs["ranks"] for call in group_factory.call_args_list] == [[0, 1], [2, 3]]
+    assert len(ps._global_process_group_list) == 2
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "options",
+    [
+        {"backend": "gloo"},
+        {"backend": "ucc"},
+        {"pg_options": object()},
+        {"use_local_synchronization": True},
+        {"reuse_existing": False},
+    ],
+)
+def test_explicitly_separate_groups_are_not_cached(group_factory, options):
+    """Requests requiring an independent group neither read nor populate the cache."""
+    cached = ps.create_group([0, 1])
+    first = ps.create_group([0, 1], **options)
+    second = ps.create_group([0, 1], **options)
+    assert first is not cached
+    assert second is not first
+    assert group_factory.call_count == 3
+    assert ps.create_group([0, 1]) is cached
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("backend", ["gloo", "cpu:gloo,cuda:nccl"])
+def test_default_non_nccl_backend_is_not_reused(group_factory, monkeypatch, backend):
+    """backend=None must not silently reuse a non-NCCL WORLD backend."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.distributed, "get_backend", lambda: backend)
+    assert ps.create_group([0, 1]) is not ps.create_group([0, 1])
+    assert group_factory.call_count == 2
+    assert not ps._PROCESS_GROUP_CACHE
+
+
+def test_membership_timeout_and_sharp_settings_remain_distinct(group_factory, monkeypatch):
+    """Different creation settings must not alias a cached communicator."""
+    first = ps.create_group([0, 1], timeout=timedelta(minutes=1))
+    assert ps.create_group([0, 2], timeout=timedelta(minutes=1)) is not first
+    assert ps.create_group([0, 1], timeout=timedelta(minutes=2)) is not first
+    monkeypatch.setenv("NCCL_COLLNET_ENABLE", "1")
+    assert ps.create_group([0, 1], timeout=timedelta(minutes=1)) is not first
+    monkeypatch.delenv("NCCL_COLLNET_ENABLE")
+    assert ps.create_group([0, 1], timeout=timedelta(minutes=1)) is first
+    assert group_factory.call_count == 4
+
+
+def test_reuse_can_be_disabled_with_an_existing_cache(group_factory, monkeypatch):
+    """The diagnostic override bypasses both cache lookup and insertion."""
+    first = ps.create_group([0, 1])
+    monkeypatch.setenv("MEGATRON_DISABLE_PROCESS_GROUP_REUSE", "1")
+    second = ps.create_group([0, 1])
+    assert second is not first
+    assert ps.create_group([0, 1]) is not second
+    monkeypatch.delenv("MEGATRON_DISABLE_PROCESS_GROUP_REUSE")
+    assert ps.create_group([0, 1]) is first
+    assert group_factory.call_count == 3
+
+
+def test_failed_group_creation_is_not_cached(group_factory):
+    """A failed collective must be attempted again on a subsequent request."""
+    group_factory.side_effect = RuntimeError("creation failed")
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="creation failed"):
+        ps.create_group([0, 1])
+    assert not ps._PROCESS_GROUP_CACHE
+    group_factory.side_effect = lambda **kwargs: object()
+    first = ps.create_group([0, 1])
+    assert ps.create_group([0, 1]) is first
+    assert group_factory.call_count == 2
+
+
+def test_all_gather_groups_preserve_independent_communicators(group_factory, monkeypatch):
+    """Dense and expert all-gathers stay separate from reduce-scatter groups."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ps, "is_initialized", lambda: True)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ps, "get_pipeline_model_parallel_world_size", lambda: 1)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ps, "get_expert_model_parallel_world_size", lambda: 2)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ps, "get_expert_tensor_parallel_world_size", lambda: 1)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ps, "get_expert_data_parallel_world_size", lambda: 2)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ps, "get_expert_gtp_weight_remat_world_size", lambda: 1)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ps, "_WEIGHT_REPLICA_RANK_SETS", [[0, 1, 2, 3]])
+    dense_rs = ps.create_group([0, 1, 2, 3])
+    expert_rs = ps.create_group([0, 2])
+    dense_ag, expert_ag = ps.create_all_gather_groups(for_expert_parallelism=True)
+    assert dense_ag is not dense_rs
+    assert expert_ag is not expert_rs
+    assert expert_ag is not None
+    next_dense_ag, next_expert_ag = ps.create_all_gather_groups(for_expert_parallelism=True)
+    assert next_dense_ag is not dense_ag
+    assert next_expert_ag is not expert_ag
+    assert ps.create_group([0, 1, 2, 3]) is dense_rs
+    assert ps.create_group([0, 2]) is expert_rs
+
+
+def test_reuse_cache_lifecycle_with_collectives(monkeypatch):
+    """Reinitialization gets fresh groups and reused handles perform real collectives."""
+    monkeypatch.delenv("MEGATRON_DISABLE_PROCESS_GROUP_REUSE", raising=False)
+    Utils.destroy_model_parallel()
+    previous = None
+    try:
+        for _ in range(2):
+            Utils.initialize_model_parallel(
+                tensor_model_parallel_size=1, pipeline_model_parallel_size=1
+            )
+            group = ps.get_data_parallel_group()
+            assert group is ps.get_data_parallel_group(with_context_parallel=True)
+            assert group is not previous
+            value = torch.ones(1, device=torch.cuda.current_device())
+            torch.distributed.all_reduce(value, group=group)
+            assert value.item() == torch.distributed.get_world_size()
+            previous = group
+            Utils.destroy_model_parallel()
+            assert not ps._PROCESS_GROUP_CACHE
+    finally:
+        Utils.destroy_model_parallel()

inline_comments.body:
Membership alone also merges groups that are meant to overlap. When expert DP is 1 (EP8 on one node, TP2 CP2 EP4, or PP×EP with EP equal to the per-stage DP), `EXPERT_MODEL_PARALLEL_GROUP` and `DATA_PARALLEL_GROUP_WITH_CP` become the same object. A `ProcessGroupNCCL` runs all of its collectives on one NCCL stream. The Megatron-FSDP docs have a probe showing that an RS and an AG on one group run back to back even when issued from different user streams (`megatron/core/distributed/fsdp/src/docs/runtime_schedule.md`). With overlap-grad-reduce, the alltoall dispatcher's A2A then waits behind in-flight grad RS buckets, and the overlapped param AG runs ahead of the forward A2A. CP at DP=1 has the same issue: `CONTEXT_PARALLEL_GROUP` merges with `DATA_PARALLEL_GROUP_WITH_CP`. Neither repro would show this. Llama has no EP, and the Nemotron layout has expert DP = 2.

I'd replace this with an explicit list of roles that may share a group:

- `dp`/`dp_cp` and `tp_dp`/`tp_dp_cp` when CP is 1
- the GTP-remat variants at size 1
- `expt_dp`/`dp_cp` when EP is 1 and ETP equals TP
- the dist-opt grad-norm group with any world-sized group
- one single-rank group per rank

Keep `ep`, `tp_ep`, `cp`, the hierarchical and dynamic CP groups, `pp`, and the AG groups separate. Main already aliases this way in one place (`_INTRA_PARTIAL_DATA_PARALLEL_GROUP_WITH_CP = _DATA_PARALLEL_GROUP_WITH_CP`).

Could you add two tests?

- A grid-parametrized test that pins which roles share and which don't, for example `ep is not dp_cp` when expert DP is 1 and `cp is not dp_cp` at DP=1.
- A real multi-rank test that every rank makes the same `new_group()` calls on a grid where ranks join different groups (PP2 or EP2). The unit tests start WORLD without `device_id`, so the eager comm-split path, where a mismatched call would hang, isn't covered today.

On GPU, the A/B I'd want is a MoE layout with expert DP = 1 and overlap-grad-reduce, overlap-param-gather and A2A overlap on, comparing step time with reuse on and off on the same backend.

+from datetime import timedelta
+from unittest.mock import Mock
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+import megatron.core.parallel_state as ps
+from tests.unit_tests.test_utilities import Utils
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def group_factory(monkeypatch):
+    """Isolate the cache and record creation without allocating communicators."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ps, "_PROCESS_GROUP_CACHE", {})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ps, "_PROCESS_GROUP_REUSE_STATS", {"created": 0, "reused": 0})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ps, "_global_process_group_list", None)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.distributed, "get_rank", lambda: 0)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.distributed, "get_backend", lambda: "nccl")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ps, "is_torch_min_version", lambda version: True)
+    monkeypatch.delenv("MEGATRON_DISABLE_PROCESS_GROUP_REUSE", raising=False)
+    monkeypatch.delenv("NCCL_COLLNET_ENABLE", raising=False)
+    factory = Mock(side_effect=lambda **kwargs: object())
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.distributed, "new_group", factory)
+    return factory
+
+
+def test_reuse_identical_nccl_group(group_factory):
+    """Equivalent membership requests reuse one registered communicator."""
+    first = ps.create_group([0, 1], timeout=timedelta(minutes=1), group_desc="first")
+    second = ps.create_group(
+        [1, 0], timeout=timedelta(minutes=1), backend="nccl", group_desc="second"
+    )
+    assert second is first
+    assert group_factory.call_count == 1
+    assert group_factory.call_args.kwargs["group_desc"] == "first"
+    assert ps._global_process_group_list == [None, first]
+    assert ps._PROCESS_GROUP_REUSE_STATS == {"created": 1, "reused": 1}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("rank", range(4))
+def test_nonmembers_make_the_same_reuse_decision(group_factory, monkeypatch, rank):
+    """Members and nonmembers enter the same sequence of new_group calls."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.distributed, "get_rank", lambda: rank)
+    nonmember = torch.distributed.GroupMember.NON_GROUP_MEMBER
+    group_factory.side_effect = lambda **kwargs: object() if rank in kwargs["ranks"] else nonmember
+    for ranks in ([0, 1], [2, 3]):
+        first = ps.create_group(ranks)
+        second = ps.create_group(ranks)
+        assert second is first
+    assert [call.kwargs["ranks"] for call in group_factory.call_args_list] == [[0, 1], [2, 3]]
+    assert len(ps._global_process_group_list) == 2
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "options",
+    [
+        {"backend": "gloo"},
+        {"backend": "ucc"},
+        {"pg_options": object()},
+        {"use_local_synchronization": True},
+        {"reuse_existing": False},
+    ],
+)
+def test_explicitly_separate_groups_are_not_cached(group_factory, options):
+    """Requests requiring an independent group neither read nor populate the cache."""
+    cached = ps.create_group([0, 1])
+    first = ps.create_group([0, 1], **options)
+    second = ps.create_group([0, 1], **options)
+    assert first is not cached
+    assert second is not first
+    assert group_factory.call_count == 3
+    assert ps.create_group([0, 1]) is cached
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("backend", ["gloo", "cpu:gloo,cuda:nccl"])
+def test_default_non_nccl_backend_is_not_reused(group_factory, monkeypatch, backend):
+    """backend=None must not silently reuse a non-NCCL WORLD backend."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.distributed, "get_backend", lambda: backend)
+    assert ps.create_group([0, 1]) is not ps.create_group([0, 1])
+    assert group_factory.call_count == 2
+    assert not ps._PROCESS_GROUP_CACHE
+
+
+def test_membership_timeout_and_sharp_settings_remain_distinct(group_factory, monkeypatch):
+    """Different creation settings must not alias a cached communicator."""
+    first = ps.create_group([0, 1], timeout=timedelta(minutes=1))
+    assert ps.create_group([0, 2], timeout=timedelta(minutes=1)) is not first
+    assert ps.create_group([0, 1], timeout=timedelta(minutes=2)) is not first
+    monkeypatch.setenv("NCCL_COLLNET_ENABLE", "1")
+    assert ps.create_group([0, 1], timeout=timedelta(minutes=1)) is not first
+    monkeypatch.delenv("NCCL_COLLNET_ENABLE")
+    assert ps.create_group([0, 1], timeout=timedelta(minutes=1)) is first
+    assert group_factory.call_count == 4
+
+
+def test_reuse_can_be_disabled_with_an_existing_cache(group_factory, monkeypatch):
+    """The diagnostic override bypasses both cache lookup and insertion."""
+    first = ps.create_group([0, 1])
+    monkeypatch.setenv("MEGATRON_DISABLE_PROCESS_GROUP_REUSE", "1")
+    second = ps.create_group([0, 1])
+    assert second is not first
+    assert ps.create_group([0, 1]) is not second
+    monkeypatch.delenv("MEGATRON_DISABLE_PROCESS_GROUP_REUSE")
+    assert ps.create_group([0, 1]) is first
+    assert group_factory.call_count == 3
+
+
+def test_failed_group_creation_is_not_cached(group_factory):
+    """A failed collective must be attempted again on a subsequent request."""
+    group_factory.side_effect = RuntimeError("creation failed")
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="creation failed"):
+        ps.create_group([0, 1])
+    assert not ps._PROCESS_GROUP_CACHE
+    group_factory.side_effect = lambda **kwargs: object()
+    first = ps.create_group([0, 1])
+    assert ps.create_group([0, 1]) is first
+    assert group_factory.call_count == 2
+
+
+def test_all_gather_groups_preserve_independent_communicators(group_factory, monkeypatch):
+    """Dense and expert all-gathers stay separate from reduce-scatter groups."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ps, "is_initialized", lambda: True)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ps, "get_pipeline_model_parallel_world_size", lambda: 1)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ps, "get_expert_model_parallel_world_size", lambda: 2)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ps, "get_expert_tensor_parallel_world_size", lambda: 1)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ps, "get_expert_data_parallel_world_size", lambda: 2)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ps, "get_expert_gtp_weight_remat_world_size", lambda: 1)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ps, "_WEIGHT_REPLICA_RANK_SETS", [[0, 1, 2, 3]])
+    dense_rs = ps.create_group([0, 1, 2, 3])
+    expert_rs = ps.create_group([0, 2])
+    dense_ag, expert_ag = ps.create_all_gather_groups(for_expert_parallelism=True)
+    assert dense_ag is not dense_rs
+    assert expert_ag is not expert_rs
+    assert expert_ag is not None
+    next_dense_ag, next_expert_ag = ps.create_all_gather_groups(for_expert_parallelism=True)
+    assert next_dense_ag is not dense_ag
+    assert next_expert_ag is not expert_ag
+    assert ps.create_group([0, 1, 2, 3]) is dense_rs
+    assert ps.create_group([0, 2]) is expert_rs
+
+

reviews.body:
Is a better fix to let each test (could be done in some test fixtures) clean up the process groups after itself? 

I've been doing this for the mfsdp_v2 bucket for the same memory-saving reason: https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/128d0970185fa74c5eadd8616903d6a14eb6bf08/tests/unit_tests/distributed/mfsdp_v2/conftest.py#L98-L100

In general, tests should be independent of other tests. See "Clean Code" Chapter 9. Reusing across tests increases the coupling, making them stateful and harder to debug.

I replayed `initialize_model_parallel()` on CPU with `new_group` mocked and grouped the parallel_state globals by object identity. With reuse off, the Llama layout joins 20 NCCL groups per rank: 14 single-rank groups and 6 that span all 8 ranks. This PR brings that to 2, which matches your numbers, so the saving is real.

My main concern is that keying on membership alone also merges groups that are meant to overlap. Details are inline. What I'd suggest instead is an explicit list of roles allowed to share a group, built per grid, plus `lazy_init` for the groups that stay separate.

On lazy init by itself: it won't recover enough here. `dp_cp` and the dist-opt grad-norm group communicate every step, so they'd still allocate. One catch when combining the two: the PR skips the cache for any group with `pg_options`, so passing `lazy_init` through `pg_options` would quietly turn reuse off for those groups.
